messages:
anna: Quick heads-up — CatalystCloud sent over the joint press pack. We need localization (FR, DE, JP), final SVG logos (full-color + mono), and confirmation on logo lockups. Target publish: Wed Mar 30 EOD. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123 :wave:

mike_design: Pulling the logos now. Can we ask for horizontal & stacked lockups? Also need vector outlines (no raster). If they only give PNGs we need replacements.

devon_marketing: For translations — do we ask Catalyst to provide or use our agency? Catalyst prefers to supply, but delays expected. Agency quote attached: https://payments.example/quote-452 :thinking_face:

sarah_partnerships: Catalyst PM (cc @catalyst-pm) said they'd try to deliver FR/DE but not JP. We should plan to localize JP in-house or via vendor.

legal_bot: Legal note: CatalystCloud granted co-marketing rights under the partner agreement. Required attribution: "CatalystCloud™ is a trademark of CatalystCloud, Inc." All press releases must be approved by both legal teams. Deadline for legal sign-off: 2026-03-30 23:59 UTC.

mike_design: File naming conv (please):
```
redwood_catalyst_press_<asset>_<variant>_<lang>.svg
examples: redwood_catalyst_press_logo_horizontal_en.svg
```

mike_design: Also need clearspace rules — does Catalyst have a lockup spec? If not, we'll apply default 8px around logo at 100px width.

devon_marketing: Checklist for publish:
- Localization files
- Final SVGs (color + mono)
- Alt text for images
- Headline + byline versions per market
- Legal sign-off
- Social tiles sized (1200x630 + 1080x1080)

sarah_partnerships: I can chase Catalyst for JP and the horizontal lockup. I'll ping them now. @mike_design please add alt text template.

mike_design: Added alt text template to the drive folder (link above). Alt sample: "Redwood Inference and CatalystCloud logos side-by-side on white background" :white_check_mark:

anna: Thanks. If anything slips we do a soft publish with FR/DE and JP follow-up. Keep me posted — I'll block time on Wed for final review. :calendar:

catalyst-pm: (external) we'll have FR/DE by Mon EOD; JP by Thu. We'll upload SVGs tonight. Note: our brand requires color #0A56FF for primary logo.

legal_bot: Reminder: include partner trademark notice and internal ticket #PR-314 for sign-off tracking.

sarah_partnerships: filing PR-314 now. ETA legal review: 24-48h once assets are in.

anna: Great. Closing loop — will update the timeline in the doc. :tada:
